label: There is at most one first mover moved by none, by Bridge to common nature…
rule: Bridge to common nature, then imported Q11 identity
meaning: Simplicity and first-being make each first mover lack a limiting principle. The OPEN bridge UnlimitedBeingsShareNature then gives one represented nature for first movers, and imported Q11NatureUniqueness.godIsOneFromNature with individuation and the adapter gives identity. Every-perfection is not used. No first mover is produced. The bridge is an unattributed open premise; its first-mover instance is not independent of uniqueness given individuation and the adapter, and only its reach beyond first movers exceeds uniqueness.
